name: Bathroom Remodeling
summary: Complete bathroom renovations including showers, waterproofing, tile, vanities, fixtures, lighting and finish work.

faqs.question: How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?
faqs.answer: The schedule depends on demolition, plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile, inspections, material availability and the final scope.

faqs.question: Can you convert a tub into a walk-in shower?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tub-to-shower conversions can include plumbing changes, slope preparation, waterproofing, tile, glass and accessibility improvements.
